items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution: authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new production admissions. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. All $4.92 is an aggregate row under tracking ID other, so site revenue and site contribution cannot be assigned. September AI usage is $950.44418695 across 5,316 calls, but it is not period-matched to the one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, cost-to-learn, forecasts, and causal lift are unknown. Continue existing repair, measurement, and reconciliation work only.

Reject revenue or ROI claims based on sessions, SEO impressions, clicks, conversions, ordered items, shipped items, AI calls, token volume, or proposal throughput. These are activity or aggregate metrics, not attributable financial outcomes. The minimum evidence is a dated ledger joining site/content identifier, revenue, orders, commissions, AI cost, infrastructure cost, labor/execution cost, and measurement period, plus a predefined learning threshold.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue and cost reconciliation using available records only. Preserve aggregate provider revenue and unavailable costs as unknown. Do not request duplicate telemetry, create new tracking, requeue work, or claim causal lift. Report the ledger gap and next measurable evidence boundary.
